description: A story-battle talk group referenced by a mission wave: a list of talk rows and parallel arrays that gate the group on battle-log conditions, plus cue sheets to preload.

Id.technical: FName key looked up in BattleTalkSetDataTables (+0xB30). StoryMissionWave.Id_BattleTalkSet supplies lookup IDs; None entries are skipped. The same Id is passed to NotifyBattleTalkEnd when all talks in the set finish. Export spells it ID (case-insensitive generator match).

CueSheetName.simple: Cue sheets whose audio should be preloaded for this set.
CueSheetName.technical: Parallel TArray<FName>; each non-None entry is appended to the story phase's collected preload names. These are not the voice row IDs themselves and are independent of Id_BattleTalk. Exported rows include None placeholders, which the consumer filters.

Id_BattleTalk.simple: Ordered list of BattleTalkDataTable rows to play.
Id_BattleTalk.technical: TArray<FName>; None entries are skipped. QueueBattleTalkSet clears the playback queue, then resolves each ID to the first BattleTalk row across DTM.BattleTalkDataTables (+0xB40); unresolved IDs are dropped. The queue order is the array order; an empty resolved queue aborts playback setup.

ValueType.simple: Battle-log statistic (or None for unconditional) for each condition slot.
ValueType.technical: TArray of EGameBattleLogValueType, indexed in lockstep with TargetType/PassiveType/Value/ConditionType. On entering a story fight, a set is queued immediately unless any element is non-None; on later ticks, non-None entries are evaluated. EvaluateLog rejects None/Invalid, maps TargetType to the player/ally/enemy character set, and sums the log values.

TargetType.simple: Whose log value is measured: ally, self, enemy, or None.
TargetType.technical: TArray<EGameBattleLogTargetType> read at the same index as ValueType and passed to EvaluateLog. Ally collects the player's team, Myself only the player, Enemy the rival team; unrecognized/None produces no candidate characters and the condition fails.

PassiveType.simple: Whether the measured value was sent or received by the target.
PassiveType.technical: TArray<EGameBattleLogPassiveType> forwarded to EvaluateLog with ValueType/TargetType. Enum values are None, Send and Receive; SumLogValues selects the corresponding send or receive log block before summing.

Value.simple: Numeric threshold compared against the measured log value.
Value.technical: TArray<float> compared with the float OutValue produced by EvaluateLog. Success_GreaterThanEquals requires Value >= array element; Success_LessThanEquals requires Value <= element. Units follow the chosen log statistic (damage, count, rate, elapsed time, etc.); there is no per-row unit field. Exported conditional rows should be checked per condition, not treated as a single global threshold.

ConditionType.simple: Comparison operator that decides whether a condition passes.
ConditionType.technical: TArray<EGameBattleLogConditionType> read only after EvaluateLog succeeds. Only Success_GreaterThanEquals and Success_LessThanEquals increment Held in the reconstructed consumer; None and the Failure_* enum members fall through to default (no credit). A set fires only when Conditions > 0 and Conditions <= Held, i.e. every non-None condition passed.

notes: The five condition arrays are parallel, not nested structs: consumers index them by the same integer and take Set->ValueType.Num() as the condition count. Mismatched array lengths in an asset could therefore produce out-of-bounds reads; no validation was observed.

Two queueing paths exist: unconditional sets (all ValueType == None) are queued once on entering the fight state; conditional sets are checked each tick while IsBattleTalkEnabled and queued once when all conditions hold.

ConditionType's Failure_GreaterThanEquals / Failure_LessThanEquals values are declared in the reconstructed enum but have no case in the observed consumer; whether retail treats them differently is unresolved.
StoryMissionWave.Id_BattleTalkSet is the join from mission content into this table; CueSheetName joins only to preloading, not to VoiceDataTable.

Loaded as a 'DataTable' primary asset named BattleTalkSetDataTable into DTM.BattleTalkSetDataTables (+0xB30). Source is reconstructed from retail code; Content is partial, so retail completeness and Blueprint uses are not asserted.

usages.detail: Fight enter: finds unconditional sets and queues them once.
Fight tick: finds sets and evaluates their parallel condition arrays.
QueueBattleTalkSet resolves Id_BattleTalk rows into the ordered playback queue.
Story phase reads CueSheetName to collect preload names.
Story phase reads Id_BattleTalk to collect portrait texture names.
